Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the void; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the void.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes three composite patches respectively on each of the members in the area of the void.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite channels are formed from laminated composite tape. 

Claim 25 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a filler disposed in a radius filler zone defined by the intersection of the cap and base with the web; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
